input.quote: A. Throughout the Term of this Agreement, M&I shall maintain at all times at its own cost and expense:
input.rationale: Section 14.1(A) is otherwise robust for a data-processing vendor: CGL of $2,000,000 (p0212-p0213), fidelity/employee dishonesty of $10,000,000 (p0214), workers' compensation as mandated by law with $500,000 employer's liability (p0215), all-risk property (p0216), plus A-rated carriers, 30 days' notice and certificates on request (p0217). However, there is no professional liability (E&O) and no cyber/privacy cover anywhere in the Agreement (searches for both return nothing), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term for a provider that processes our customer data. We therefore propose the minimal fallback fix: add E&O of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of $2,000,000 as a new item in the existing § 14.1(A) list, leaving § 14.1(B)'s certificate mechanic (which covers "the coverage required by this Section") to pick up the new lines automatically. We have not pushed the CGL split limits or the higher preferred amounts, since the fallback threshold resolves the gap.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Add professional liability (E&O) of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy liability of $2,000,000 to M&I's § 14.1(A) insurance schedule.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] M&I's insurance schedule carries no professional liability or cyber cover, which is our minimum position for a provider that processes our customer data. We have added E&O of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of $2,000,000 to the existing § 14.1(A) list, so the existing carrier-rating and certificate mechanics in § 14.1(B) apply unchanged.

ops.text: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance in an amount not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000), and Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000).
